module: Extension managing fifth wheel type hitches. It reacts to beamstate events (enabling/disabling of automatic coupling, detaching) by relaying them to the 'couplings/fifthwheel' controllers and answers beamstate's questions about the coupling state.
usage:
-- called by beamstate, not by the modder directly
extensions.couplings.isCouplerAttached()
notes: isAutoCouplingActive always returns false; isCouplerAttached returns true if at least one fifth wheel is attached, otherwise nil (not false).
couplingAttached calls obj:stopLatching() then beamstate.disableAutoCoupling(): automatic coupling is cut as soon as a coupling is made.

couplingAttached.desc: Called by the engine/beamstate when a coupler attaches: stops the automatic latching and disables auto coupling.

obj2nodeId.desc: Coupler node of the other vehicle.

couplingDetached.desc: Called when a coupler detaches; does nothing.

onBeamstateActivateAutoCoupling.desc: Called by beamstate on activation of automatic coupling: displays the indicator of each fifth wheel.

onBeamstateDisableAutoLatching.desc: Called by beamstate on deactivation of automatic coupling: hides the indicator of each fifth wheel.

onBeamstateDetachCouplers.desc: Called by beamstate to detach the couplers: detaches each fifth wheel.

isAutoCouplingActive.desc: Indicates whether automatic coupling is active for this extension (always false).

isCouplerAttached.desc: Indicates whether at least one fifth wheel is attached.
